name: Cripple
description: A landed attack drains %stat_steal% point of every attribute from the target and transfers it to this unit, plus %defended_bonus% extra points of whichever attribute the target defended with, along with %hp_steal% maximum and current health. Against anything tougher than a basic unit every amount is multiplied by %non_basic_multiplier%. An attack that is successfully defended still shaves %stat_steal% point off the defending attribute, but drains no health.
